pathogens.note: Population-weighted blend of NYC DEP's 14 treatment plants (digital PCR only, since April 2023), fixed plant offsets, 2-week trailing mean. Weeks NYC has not yet published are filled from CDC's level for the same plants and marked provisional. CDC category: median of the plants in the latest CDC week with at least 10 reporting.
